summary: Block SSH passwords for the service account with `Match User ansible` / `PasswordAuthentication no` in `/etc/sshd/sshd_config.d/60-ansible.conf`, check with `sudo sshd -t` and restart `sshd.service`; add public keys matching the AAP Machine credentials to `/home/ansible/.ssh/authorized_keys`. One account is used, but teams can each use their own keys.
questions: How do I disable password SSH for the ansible user only?
sshd Match User PasswordAuthentication no example
Do all managed nodes need the same SSH key?
Where do I put the AAP public key on managed nodes?

answer_card.title: SSH keys only for the service account
answer_card.answer_md:
```
# /etc/sshd/sshd_config.d/60-ansible.conf
Match User ansible
	PasswordAuthentication no
```
```bash
sudo sshd -t
sudo systemctl restart sshd.service
```
Append the Machine credential's public key to `/home/ansible/.ssh/authorized_keys`.
